attributes.name: Mongrel Archer
attributes.powers:
The difficulty of the check to acquire the Mongrel Archer is equal to the highest difficulty to acquire a random weapon weapon from the box.

Recharge this card to add 1d6 to your Ranged combat check; if you fail the check, the damage you are dealt is increased by 1d6.

Discard this card to explore your location.
